industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Manufacturing > Railway Wagons

operating_notes.text: Touax Texmaco Railcar Leasing Private Limited issued 3,16,70,588 shares and 76,893 CCDs to TrinityRail Global Inc., revising holding to 34% (plus 1 share) for Touax, 34% (minus 1 share) for Texmaco, and 32% for TrinityRail.
Received ₹0.74 Cr (incl taxes) LoA from South Western Railway for nylon mesh on TTC and portals in SBC division, executable in 10 months.
Share of private sector and export orders in Freight Car Division increased from 21% in FY25 to 79% in FY26 and further to 96.4% in Q1 FY27
Bright Power (Electrical Infra) revenue increased 76.8% YoY to INR175 crores in Q1FY27
Rail Infra & Green business reported positive EBIT margin of 1.4% in Q1FY27 compared to EBIT loss in corresponding quarter last year
Signed MoU with The Signalling Company NV (Belgium) for ETCS and Kavach signalling development in India.
Won ₹77.76 Cr purchase order (incl. taxes) from IVC Logistics to supply 3 rakes of ACT1 wagons and 1 BVCM wagon per rake by March 31, 2027.
Texmaco Defence Technologies had FY26 net worth of ₹0.01 Cr and zero revenue before the ₹200 Cr investment agreement.
Texmaco Defence Technologies Limited reported total income of ₹0.01 Cr in FY26 and nil turnover for the last 3 years.
Entered into a 12-month exclusive MoU with Germany's BVV on 27 August 2026 to explore a JV for railway wheels, wheelsets, and axles.
Received Letter of Award of USD 135M from Tsiko Africa Logistics and Barberry Holdings for Wabtec ES43ACi locomotives, executable within 20-24 months of definitive agreement.
Awarded ₹24.48 Cr order (incl. taxes) from Transport Corporation of India Limited for 1 rake of ACT-1 and BVCM wagons to be executed within 16 weeks from LOI.

Received two wagon orders aggregating ₹131.36 Cr (incl. taxes): ₹24.48 Cr from TCI for 1 rake of ACT-1 and BVCM wagons (16 weeks), and ₹106.88 Cr from JV Touax Texmaco for 4 rakes of BFNS22.9 wagons and 4 BVCM wagons (by 26 May 2027).
Bagged ₹27.82 Cr order (incl. taxes) from Hindalco Industries for 1 BTAP rake and 1 Brake Van for Aditya Expansion Project, execution within 8 months of PO.
Subsidiary Texmaco Defence Technologies signed SPA to acquire 100% of Indolem Technologies Systems for ₹8 lakh cash.

timeline.summary: Touax Texmaco Railcar Leasing JV allotted 32% stake to TrinityRail Global Inc., revising Texmaco's holding to 34% (minus 1 share).
Received ₹0.74 Cr LoA from South Western Railway for bird nest prevention mesh to be executed in 10 months.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹756.68 Cr (-16.9% YoY), net profit ₹50.07 Cr (+70.7% YoY).
Texmaco Rail reported Q1FY27 standalone revenue of ₹753 Cr, EBITDA margin of 10.8%, and order book of ₹9,923 Cr as of June 30, 2026.
Signed MoU with The Signalling Company NV (Belgium) to collaborate on ETCS and Kavach train protection solutions for India.
Bagged ₹77.76 Cr wagon supply order from IVC Logistics Limited for 3 rakes of ACT1 wagons, due by March 2027.
Texmaco Rail entered into an SSSA for up to ₹200 Cr investment in subsidiary Texmaco Defence Technologies Ltd by Calculus, diluting parent stake to 70%.
Texmaco Rail invested ₹6.88 Cr in subsidiary Texmaco Defence Technologies Ltd, diluting parent stake to 70% as Vagus Def Tech acquired 30%.
Executed an exclusive 12-month MoU with Bochumer Verein Verkehrstechnik GmbH (BVV) to explore a joint venture in India for railway wheels and wheelsets.
Received USD 135M Letter of Award for diesel-electric locomotives from Tsiko Africa Logistics and Barberry Holdings.
Texmaco Rail secured a ₹24.48 Cr (incl. taxes) order from Transport Corporation of India for 1 rake of wagons, executable in 16 weeks.
Received wagon orders aggregating ₹131.36 Cr (incl. taxes) from TCI (₹24.48 Cr) and JV Touax Texmaco Railcar Leasing (₹106.88 Cr).
Secured ₹27.82 Cr order from Hindalco Industries to supply 1 BTAP rake and 1 Brake Van within 8 months.
Texmaco Rail held its 28th AGM on 18 September 2026; all resolutions passed with requisite majority.
Texmaco Rail's subsidiary Texmaco Defence signed an SPA to acquire 100% of Indolem Technologies Systems for ₹8 lakh.
